changelog.text: Adapter tests finish: a test no longer stops itself when its own setting change briefly restarts Wi-Fi. When an adapter test waits, the log says why (PC in use, a game or call, other traffic). Three backup upload test servers, so upload tests work when Cloudflare refuses, and the log names each server that refused and why.

Adapter tests now measure lag under load (before, they only compared idle ping). When a speed-test server refuses, the registry and adapter tests switch to another server instead of throwing the measurement away, and PCs where uploads are blocked are measured with downloads alone. Shared anonymous statistics are sent reliably, also on battery, and turning sharing off stops a batch that is still being sent. Settings are tested more often while you use the PC, so in simulation the first kept setting comes after 4.1 instead of 5.3 hours of use.

Tests no longer stall after a reconnect, so Deep Tune measures again. Cloudflare speed tests work again. No test data limits at all. Speed tests, the benchmark and Deep Tune keep running during games, calls, downloads and on battery. Settings that can briefly interrupt the network adapter switch only in quiet moments, never mid-game. Deep Tune never restarts the PC during a game or call. No fake game-server packet loss on short sessions. Problem reports remove your user and PC names from the log.

No more self-caused regular packet loss: adapter settings switch only when the connection is quiet, and a setting that will not apply is skipped instead of retried. Settings are no longer wrongly called worse. Pings a server refuses no longer count as loss. Minecraft and other local game servers no longer show fake 0.2 ms pings. No monthly test data limit.

Tests now finish and get kept: games, calls, downloads, battery and changes in what you are doing no longer cancel them, and every stopped test logs why. Deep Tune keeps the PC awake, wakes it with a timer if it sleeps, keeps going until it has measured, and never claims a result it did not measure.
30 more network settings, each measured and undone if it does not help; a restore point before the first change; Game mode.
Scorio's data folder is secured reliably at every start.
Learned game lookups are saved reliably, including while Windows shuts down.
Clearer data limit message; registry backup notes logged once.
New Apps page: choose per app whether Scorio protects it (Automatic, Always protect or Never protect).
Deep Tune measures before it restarts; adapter tests no longer interrupt Deep Tune speed tests.

No more swinging (remembers the best setup per situation); better call detection; Deep Tune restarts made safe; test data capped and labeled as Scorio tests; fewer false alarms; window frees memory on close; lower CPU.

Browser calls protected separately from downloads; upload lag limiter; DNS never stays slower; your own setting changes respected; smarter judge and AI model; Deep Tune with real load; honest benchmark; lag explanations, pre-match check, ISP report; less memory when the window is closed.

The Scorio app with live dashboard, tuning, benchmark, sessions, diagnostics, Watcher and one-click reports; combination search that keeps only settings that win on their own; Deep Tune; safer updates.

Testing never stops: TCP/UDP settings tested during games, calls and on battery; registry settings tested across restarts; IPv4/IPv6 preference per network; session reports; connection score to the game server.
21 TCP/UDP setting changes tested with evidence; instant updates; Revert-Scorio; Minecraft and Discord screen-share recognition.
Connection score; instant TCP self-tests; kept settings survive restarts; DNS switches on steady gains; low CPU priority.
Updates wait only for a game or voice call.
Measured TCP experiments during big downloads and uploads.
DNS checked every 5 seconds with instant failover.
Signed automatic updates.
